entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return something. Order 774-B-91.
Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order... 774-B-91. I see an order for the VeloFit Pro-Lite cycling shoes. Is that correct?
Alright. To make sure I understand, could you tell me a bit about the issue? Is it a technical fault with the shoes or more of a preference issue?
They gave me blisters. I tried adjusting the cleats a dozen times, but nothing worked. They just don't fit.
I'm sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me check the return eligibility for you.

Okay, I've reviewed your order. It looks like you received the cycling shoes 77 days ago. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within the window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you.
Wow. Lucky me. So what do I do?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email shortly with a prepaid shipping label. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Whatever. As long as I get my money back.
Absolutely. You can expect that email within the next 15 minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
